# freshdesk_account (Data Source)

Details of the helpdesk account the provider is configured for. Useful for asserting that a configuration is pointed at the right tenant, and for reading the plan tier that gates several features.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "freshdesk_account" "current" {}

output "helpdesk" {
  value = "${data.freshdesk_account.current.account_name} on ${data.freshdesk_account.current.tier_type}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `account_domain` (String) Primary Freshdesk domain of the account.
- `account_name` (String) Name of the account.
- `collaborators` (Number) Number of collaborator seats in use.
- `contact_email` (String) Email address of the account's primary contact.
- `contact_name` (String) Name of the account's primary contact.
- `data_center` (String) Region the account is hosted in.
- `field_agents` (Number) Number of field service agent seats in use.
- `full_time_agents` (Number) Number of full-time agent seats in use.
- `hipaa_compliant` (Boolean) Whether the account is provisioned for HIPAA.
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the account.
- `occasional_agents` (Number) Number of occasional agent seats in use.
- `organisation_id` (String) Identifier of the Freshworks organisation.
- `organisation_name` (String) Name of the Freshworks organisation.
- `tier_type` (String) Plan the account is on, for example `Enterprise Omni`.
- `timezone` (String) Default time zone of the helpdesk.
- `type` (String) Whether the account is classic or unified-omni.
